name: stateNames
title: Names of a model’s states
description: Returns state names in rate-matrix order. Ordinary models use alphabet symbols. Tuffley–Steel models prefix each input state name with OFF: or ON:; general Markov modulation prefixes it with a one-based regime index. Nested modulation retains these prefixes. These names can be used as keys for nonEq root frequencies and MutSel fitnesses.
